paper.title: Synapse: Trajectory-as-Exemplar Prompting with Memory for Computer Control
paper.central_claim: State abstraction enables complete trajectory-as-exemplar prompting; similarity-based exemplar memory improves generalization, reaching99.2% success on64 MiniWoB++ tasks with examples from48 tasks and56% relative average StepSR improvement on Mind2Web.
